Paragraph: "My mind is torn between admiring this beauty and sinking into sorrow for my beloved, Lakshmana..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama suffers from severe internal cognitive and emotional conflict between aesthetic joy and deep grief.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama openly articulates his inner psychological conflict and dual emotional state.
Outcome/Resolution: He identifies the ongoing struggle within his mind.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Internal Conflict, Divided Mind, Emotional Strain

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Dvandva (The conflict of dualities operating simultaneously within the mind)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Shows the soul navigating the tension between external world perception and internal emotional truth during human existence.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Cognitive-emotional ambivalence: struggling to reconcile moments of external appreciation with overwhelming internal grief.
